source: Curiosity REMS weather station, sol 196 (Feb 2013), hourly means by local mean solar time. Wind was measured in 14 of the 24 hours (one of the two wind booms was damaged at landing); the other hours are filled in from their neighbours. NASA PDS Atmospheres Node (J. Gomez-Elvira et al.)
tauSource: Curiosity Mastcam images of the Sun at 880 nm, sol 198 (1 measurement; M. Lemmon)
stormTauSource: Curiosity Mastcam at Gale, sol 2085, in the 2018 planet-wide dust storm (Guzewich et al. 2019)
